title: 第11章 焚毁与新发现第12章 特殊金属冯睦不太对劲
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
高耸的烟囱，黑烟汩汩冒涌，整个焚化厂被雾霾笼罩，空气污染指数简直肉眼可见。
冯睦吸吸鼻子，一股浓郁的难以形容的味道钻入鼻腔，就像是沤臭的尸体，被洁厕灵冲刷过，又臭又香，让人反胃。
王建连忙掏出副口罩递过去，说：“很难闻吧？我刚来的时候也受不了，待两天就适应了，唔，戴上口罩也能隔绝大部分气味儿。”
冯睦道谢后，打量了下，比前世的医用口罩稍厚一些。
戴上口罩，气味儿削减许多，至少不会引起生理性呕吐了。
冯睦问道：“这是焚烧厄尸的味道？”
王建点点头又摇摇头：“焚化厂内分好多个区域，烧厄尸只是其中一部分，还有焚烧污染物，辐射物，废物垃圾等等，但最刺鼻的的确是厄尸的气味儿。”
冯睦咽口唾沫：“空气有毒吗？”
王建挠挠脑袋：“焚烧前都经过消毒处理了，所以厂里给出的说法是没有，但是厂里工人私底下都觉得有，所以，冯睦，你还要来吗？”
冯睦不以为然道：“没事，你不也在这儿吗，我把口罩戴好就行。”
王建脸上露出亲近的笑容：“嗯，毒肯定是有一点的，但危害没外人想的那么大，我爸在焚烧厂干了快20年，我也没见他有啥事儿。”
冯睦点头，不动声色的把口罩边缘捏紧些。
王建以前在班里，其实没咋跟冯睦说过话，但都是一批退学loser，离校再见，就莫名觉得容易亲近了。
王建想了想，压低声音道：“其实吧，这工作平日清闲不说，有时候还能捡点意想不到的的好处。”
冯睦对王建口中的好处兴趣不大，但脸上还是恰当好处的露出好奇之色：“啥意思？”
王建故意不答，卖个关子：“走吧，你没见过厄尸吧，我带你去瞅瞅，运气好的话，说不定……”
王建嘿嘿笑两声，故作神秘。
冯睦眼睛一亮，扯了扯书包带子，兴致勃勃的跟在王建身后。
…….
闷热的温度把空气蒸腾出涟漪。

王建拉开焚化炉的舱门，弯腰扛起地上黑色的裹尸袋，熟练地扔在台子上，然后扒开裹尸袋的拉链。
王建：“瞧，这就是厄尸。”
冯睦眼睛瞪圆，他在网络上也看见过厄尸的图片，但近距离实物带来的视觉冲击，还是给他的心灵带来不小的震撼。
长满肉疙瘩的脑袋，胸膛诡异的凹陷，狰狞的肋骨犬牙交错像食人的利口，两条胳膊也扭曲的不成样子，只有下身两条大腿能依稀看出曾经人形的模样。
冯睦手捂住嘴巴，骇然失色：“比图片上的还恐怖，难以想象人类能畸变成这种模样。”
王建第一次见厄尸，饭都吐出来了，这会儿依旧没能适应，却强撑着脸色，镇静道：“我怀疑网络上的图片，都是经过修图处理的，不然，一想到练武出了岔子，有可能变成这种鬼样子，还有几个学生敢练武啊。”
厄尸的成因尚未有明确定论。
但主流说法有两种：
一种是核辐射在体内积累过量，导致基因突变；
一种是练武到一定境界后，出了岔子，或者走上邪路，导致细胞畸变。
冯睦下意识摸了摸胸口的阴凉，对王建露出一个惨白的笑容：“你说的有道理，我现在觉得咱们退学也不完全是坏事。”
王建拉上拉链，强忍恶心，把尸体推进焚化舱，启动火化。
焚化舱底部密密麻麻的孔洞内火焰喷涌，化作成百上千道火蛇缠裹住厄尸，贪婪的蚀骨吸髓。
王建扭头看着冯睦，挤出笑容道：“是啊，我祝愿班里那群高考生，都能考上大学，武道精进，然后有朝一日，统统来我这里。”
冯睦无语的点点头，然后似想到了什么，连忙脱下书包，作势就要往焚化炉里扔。
content_en:
Towering chimneys, black smoke billowing out, the entire incineration plant was shrouded in smog, and the air pollution index was almost visible to the naked eye.
Feng Mu sniffed, and a strong, indescribable smell penetrated his nasal cavity. It was like a stinking corpse that had been washed away by a toilet cleaner. It was smelly and fragrant, making people feel sick to his stomach.
Wang Jian quickly took out a mask and handed it over, saying, "Doesn't it smell bad? I couldn't stand it when I first came here. I got used to it after two days. Well, wearing a mask can also block most of the smell."
After Feng Mu thanked him, he looked at it and found that it was slightly thicker than the medical mask in his previous life.
Wearing a mask will reduce the smell a lot, at least it will not cause physiological vomiting.
Feng Mu asked: "Is this the smell of burning corpses?"
Wang Jian nodded and shook his head: "The incineration plant is divided into many areas. Burning corpses is only one part of it. There are also burning pollutants, radiation, waste, etc., but the most pungent smell is indeed the smell of corpses."
Feng Mu swallowed: "Is the air poisonous?"
Wang Jian scratched his head: "It was disinfected before incineration, so the factory said it was not true, but the workers in the factory privately felt that it was true, so, Feng Mu, are you still coming?"
Feng Mu said disapprovingly: "It's okay, aren't you here too? I just put on the mask."
A friendly smile appeared on Wang Jian's face: "Well, it is definitely poisonous, but the harm is not as great as outsiders think. My dad has worked in the incineration plant for almost 20 years, and I haven't seen anything happen to him."
Feng Mu nodded and quietly pinched the edge of the mask tighter.
Wang Jian was in the class before and actually didn't talk to Feng Mu very much, but they were all losers who dropped out of school. When they saw each other after leaving school, they felt inexplicably easy to get close to.
Wang Jian thought for a while, then lowered his voice and said, "Actually, this job is usually very relaxing, and sometimes you can get some unexpected benefits."
Feng Mu was not very interested in the benefits mentioned by Wang Jian, but his face still showed an appropriately curious look: "What do you mean?"
Wang Jian deliberately didn't answer and pretended to be a lie: "Let's go, you haven't seen the corpse before, I'll take you to take a look. If you're lucky, maybe..."
Wang Jian chuckled twice, pretending to be mysterious.
Feng Mu's eyes lit up, he tugged on the strap of his schoolbag, and followed Wang Jian enthusiastically.
….
The sweltering temperature ripples the air.
Wang Jian opened the door of the incinerator, bent down to pick up the black body bag on the ground, threw it skillfully on the table, and then unzipped the body bag.
Wang Jian: "Look, this is the corpse."
Feng Mu's eyes widened. He had also seen pictures of evil corpses on the Internet, but the visual impact of the real thing at close range still shocked his soul.
The head is covered with fleshy lumps, the chest is strangely sunken, the ferocious ribs are intertwined like canine teeth, and the two arms are twisted out of shape. Only the two thighs of the lower body can vaguely show the appearance of the human form.
Feng Mu covered his mouth with his hands and turned pale with horror: "It's even more terrifying than the one in the picture. It's hard to imagine that human beings can be deformed into this kind of appearance."
The first time Wang Jian saw Ershi, he vomited out his food. He still couldn't adapt to it, but he kept his face and said calmly: "I suspect that the pictures on the Internet have been edited. Otherwise, when I think about martial arts training gone wrong, it might become like this. How many students dare to practice martial arts."
The cause of the disaster has not yet been determined.
But there are two mainstream opinions:
One is that excessive accumulation of nuclear radiation in the body leads to genetic mutations;
One is that after practicing martial arts to a certain level, something goes wrong or goes astray, causing cell distortion.
Feng Mu subconsciously touched the coolness on his chest and showed a pale smile to Wang Jian: "What you said makes sense. Now I think it's not entirely a bad thing for us to drop out of school."
Wang Jian zipped up the zipper, suppressed his nausea, pushed the body into the incineration chamber, and started the cremation.
Dense holes at the bottom of the incineratorThe inner flames spurted out, turning into hundreds of fiery snakes that wrapped around the corpse, greedily eating away at the bones and sucking out the marrow.
Wang Jian turned to look at Feng Mu, squeezed out a smile and said, "Yes, I wish that all the college entrance examination students in the class can be admitted to university, improve their martial arts, and then one day they will all come to my place."
Feng Mu nodded speechlessly, then seemed to think of something, and quickly took off his schoolbag, pretending to throw it into the incinerator.
